connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Rootly*Rootly CloudRootly Server (to be supported)If you are using Rootly Cloud, you do not need to enter the endpoint URL, which is https://api.rootly.com/v1/.Token*ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access Rootly directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake uses 3,600 requests/hour for data collection for Rootly.
